town_description: Karnal is a historic city in eastern Haryana on the Grand Trunk Road, traditionally associated with Karna of the Mahabharata and said to have been founded as Karnalaya by him. It is a major centre of agricultural research, hosting the National Dairy Research Institute, the Central Soil Salinity Research Institute, and the National Bureau of Animal Genetic Resources. The city is also the hometown of astronaut Kalpana Chawla, memorialised at the Kalpana Chawla Memorial Planetarium.
